title: Final Radius Estimate
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide a reasonable estimate for the radius of the neutron star, showing the final answer clearly.

title: Gravitational Potential Energy
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the expression for gravitational potential energy correctly and relate it to the pressure of the Fermi gas.

title: Pressure of Fermi Gas
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly express the pressure of the degenerate Fermi gas and equate it to the gravitational pressure.

title: Neutron Density Argument
description: Essential Criteria: The student must explain why the neutron star can be considered to consist almost entirely of neutrons, addressing the role of electron and proton presence.

title: Energy Conservation Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should discuss energy conservation in the context of neutron decay and the implications for the presence of electrons and protons.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the equations.
